$ corvex run alpha --plain --yes

--- stdout ---
(empty)

--- stderr ---
Run "alpha": 1 pending task(s) · ceilings: <COST>/run, <COST>/task

--- error ---
run failed: working tree has 1 uncommitted change(s):
  dirty.txt

Corvex won't run on a dirty tree: it commits a checkpoint after every task, and its crash-recovery reset could discard this work.
→ commit or stash your changes, then re-run
→ or pass --force to let corvex reset the tree first (DESTRUCTIVE — discards the changes above)
